strategic_themes.label: Application and Approval
strategic_themes.definition: Themes related to applying for, obtaining, and modifying credit products.

midlevel_themes.label: Approval Process
midlevel_themes.definition: Elements that describe how quickly and under what conditions an application is decided.

specific_themes.label: Approval Time
specific_themes.definition: Time elapsed between submission of an application and the issuance of a decision.

specific_themes.label: Application Requirements
specific_themes.definition: Documents, data, or conditions that must be supplied to submit an application.

specific_themes.label: Term Adjustability
specific_themes.definition: Ability to modify credit line terms after the initial approval.

midlevel_themes.label: Account Change
midlevel_themes.definition: Processes that modify existing account details after activation.

specific_themes.label: Account Change Speed
specific_themes.definition: Time required for a requested change to become effective.

specific_themes.label: Account Change Success
specific_themes.definition: Whether requested account changes are applied without error.

strategic_themes.label: Product Features
strategic_themes.definition: Core capabilities and characteristics of the bank’s products.

midlevel_themes.label: Invoice Financing
midlevel_themes.definition: Features that allow financing of invoices.

specific_themes.label: Invoice Payment Schedule
specific_themes.definition: Timing and amounts of payments made on financed invoices.

specific_themes.label: Invoice Automation
specific_themes.definition: Automated handling of invoice processing within the platform.

midlevel_themes.label: Savings Account
midlevel_themes.definition: Characteristics of the savings‑type product offered.

specific_themes.label: Savings Terms Clarity
specific_themes.definition: How clearly account lock‑up periods and rates are communicated.

specific_themes.label: Savings Rate Competitiveness
specific_themes.definition: Relative attractiveness of the interest rate offered on savings.

midlevel_themes.label: Credit Line Suitability
midlevel_themes.definition: Fit of the credit line product for different business sizes and needs.

specific_themes.label: Fit for Small Business
specific_themes.definition: Extent to which the credit line meets needs of small or early‑stage firms.

specific_themes.label: Fit for Large Business
specific_themes.definition: Extent to which the credit line meets needs of larger enterprises.

specific_themes.label: Credit Line Flexibility
specific_themes.definition: Ease of adjusting credit line limits or terms without re‑applying.

strategic_themes.label: Pricing and Fees
strategic_themes.definition: Cost structures, fee transparency, and interest‑rate characteristics.

midlevel_themes.label: Fee Structure
midlevel_themes.definition: Overall composition and visibility of fees charged to customers.

specific_themes.label: Fee Structure Overview
specific_themes.definition: Clarity, level, and number of distinct fee categories applied.

midlevel_themes.label: Interest Rate
midlevel_themes.definition: Characteristics of interest rates applied to credit products.

specific_themes.label: Interest Rate Details
specific_themes.definition: Type of rate (fixed or variable) and how changes are communicated and applied.

midlevel_themes.label: Contract Clarity
midlevel_themes.definition: Consistency and understandability of contractual documentation.

specific_themes.label: Contract Clarity Overview
specific_themes.definition: Degree to which contracts are clear, consistent, and easily accessed.

strategic_themes.label: Digital Platform
strategic_themes.definition: Usability, performance, and integration capabilities of the online portal and mobile app.

midlevel_themes.label: Portal Usability
midlevel_themes.definition: How easily users can navigate and obtain information within the portal.

specific_themes.label: Portal Usability Overview
specific_themes.definition: Clarity of interface elements and overall loading/performance behavior.

midlevel_themes.label: Mobile Access
midlevel_themes.definition: Availability and functionality of a mobile application.

specific_themes.label: Mobile App Availability
specific_themes.definition: Whether a dedicated mobile application is offered to customers.

midlevel_themes.label: Integration and Reporting
midlevel_themes.definition: Reliability of data exchange with external systems and historical reporting.

specific_themes.label: Integration Reliability
specific_themes.definition: Consistency and success rate of integrations with bookkeeping or ERP systems.

specific_themes.label: Historical Statement Access
specific_themes.definition: Availability of past account statements within the platform.

strategic_themes.label: Customer Service
strategic_themes.definition: Interactions with support staff, channels, and overall responsiveness.

midlevel_themes.label: Support Response
midlevel_themes.definition: Timeliness and effectiveness of replies across support channels.

specific_themes.label: Support Response Overview
specific_themes.definition: Speed of replies and overall effectiveness of the channel used.

specific_themes.label: Staff Interaction
specific_themes.definition: Behaviour of staff and continuity of personal contact across interactions.

midlevel_themes.label: Advisor Interaction
midlevel_themes.definition: Quality and accessibility of advisory personnel.

specific_themes.label: Advisor Interaction Overview
specific_themes.definition: Expertise of advisors and ease of reaching them.

strategic_themes.label: Account Management
strategic_themes.definition: Controls and processes for managing user access and closing accounts.

midlevel_themes.label: Multi‑User Access
midlevel_themes.definition: Management of multiple users and role assignments within an account.

specific_themes.label: User Role Management
specific_themes.definition: Assigning and maintaining different permission levels for users.

midlevel_themes.label: Termination Process
midlevel_themes.definition: Steps and speed of closing or revoking a credit line.

specific_themes.label: Termination Process Overview
specific_themes.definition: Procedures for ending a credit line and any associated delays.
